newsitem.title: FRANCE: Alcatel 96 net income 2.7 bln Ffr, div up.
newsitem.headline: Alcatel 96 net income 2.7 bln Ffr, div up.

text.p: (Figures in millions of French francs unless stated)
Net income attrib (billions) profit 2.7 vs loss 25.6
NOTE - Alcatel Alsthom said in a statement that its actions underpinned its objective of a return to satisfactory profitability by 1998.
NOTE - The group said R&D expenses amounted to 16.6 billion francs or 10.2 percent of sales and that this was the same as last year.

Income from operations, calculated before financial results, reached 2.9 billion francs compared to 0.6 billion francs last time round. The group said this levels was "relatively low and confirms the need to continue the vigorous actions undertaken for the group's recovery within the established time frame".
According to results presentation slides, the group said it would seek to improve gross operating margin by two points a year despite annual price reductions of around 10 percent.
The group also said it had exceeded its goal of 10 billion francs from the sale of non-strategic assets.
